5256-7084-8337.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

512-1355-4644.easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-1355-4644.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
512-1355-4644.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1355-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Sanctum Weaver's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

339-677-969-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5147-6112.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5147-6112.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6153-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6153-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6153-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2239-4377-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4986-5147-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
4986-5147-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

240-1879-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1809-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2034-4766-4825-7091.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Emrakul, adding {C}{C}.
When Emrakul dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Emrakul trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Emrakul and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
2034-4766-4825-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Emrakul or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Emrakul with the returned creature for that iteration.

1182-1940-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library.
Repeat.

3532-4908-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-4908-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

4927-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3951-5703-5929-6441.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-5703-5929-6441.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2136-4600-6567.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk with haste.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
2136-4600-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 60 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

2292-2534-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1809-1987-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1809-1987-2556-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Returned Pastcaller.
When Mnemonic Wall and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-2556-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

654-1479-3703-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-3703-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sporemound and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

428-1692-1694-1844.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
428-1692-1694-1844.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

2506-6182.description:
Cast Supreme Exemplar by paying its mana cost.
When Supreme Exemplar enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Supreme Exemplar with haste.
When the Supreme Exemplar token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Supreme Exemplar until the token Supreme Exemplar leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Supreme Exemplar.
The token Supreme Exemplar leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Supreme Exemplar from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2921-5624.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2254-2825-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2254-2825-3263-4222.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Songs of the Damned without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Songs of the Damned, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

963-4050-4763-5177.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
963-4050-4763-5177.description:
Cast Arcbound Javelineer by paying {W}.
Arcbound Javelineer enters the battlefield, triggering Veteran's Armaments, attaching it to Arcbound Javelineer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Javelineer, adding {W}.
Arcbound Javelineer dies, triggering itself and Koll.
Resolve Arcbound Javelineer's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on target artifact creature.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Arcbound Javelineer from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2464-3525-4723.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle and Pemmin's Aura attached to Night Market Lookout.
Night Market Lookout does not have summoning sickness.
2464-3525-4723.description:
Activate Night Market Lookout by tapping it, adding {U}.
Night Market Lookout triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Night Market Lookout.
Repeat.

1283-2034-2577.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1987-3075-3277.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-3075-3277.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Izzet Chronarch and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
